Played again after some years. There are enemies now that you need a team mate to free you from. So now you can't play alone in all mission types and sometimes randoms simply dont care. Another mission objective added requires listening to some faint sounds I cannot hear at all. The new weapons are worse than the old ones. The clutter and extreme FOMO pushing with the seasons make it feel like a mobile game with a high budget.

All around a downgrade and unfun to play.

You are a space dwarf. You drop onto a planet in a big drilling pod and explore caves to gather valuable minerals alongside up to three friends. The game is relatively simple to learn, even for a shooter, and the difficulty scales rather well. The complex and seemingly random cave generation ensures that no cave is like any other. There is always something to explore each mission. Every class is viable, and benefits greatly when allies of other classes are present due to each unique way the classes present their mobility tools. Engineers can provide solid platforms for Scouts to grapple up to for veins in high places, Gunners can provide zip-lines that everyone can ride for easy traversal of large caverns, and Drillers can quickly make holes in walls and clear out terrain to give everyone room to stand, or easily collect the larger chunks of minerals hidden deeper in the rock.

Oh, and the mission objectives are fun to complete too. A basic mining mission will have you explore the cave while gathering minerals. There are also point extraction missions, which your team is given a small base to bring minerals to as well as extraction missions, where you must recover the tools of a previous mining crew's failure and use it to escape. There are also egg hunts, which you have to dig into the walls to collect the eggs of the creatures you have to fight through each mission. You can imagine, they don't take that too well. If that doesn't sound dangerous enough, then there are also extermination missions, where you must locate and... well... exterminate some of the toughest enemies the critters have to offer.

The game's simplicity is very pleasing, and the depth is exciting to dig into. You can go on the same mission type over and over and still be enjoying yourself since you are exploring a new cave every mission you go on and have to come up with varying solutions to traverse every dig. Rock and stone, to the bone!
